title: POS Configs
description: Point of sale shops and till settings.

help.title: About POS Configs
help.overview: A POS config is one till. It needs a name, at least one payment method, and at least one warehouse. A cashier opens a session on that till and sells against its price list.

sections.title: What the cashier can do
sections.body: The till price is the variant price, or the product price when the line has no variant. The till does not accept a price typed by the cashier.
items: Payment methods are the buttons on the till. Warehouses are the stock locations that till can sell from.
An optional fiscal config links this till to Albanian fiscalization. Receipt header and footer are printed on the receipt.
Allow discount, quantity change, and oversell control the cashier. PIN for discount, cash out, and refund asks for a manager PIN before that action.
Cash control tracks the drawer. The barcode scanner flag turns scanning on for this till.

sections.title: Pause and resume
sections.body: An inactive till, a paused till, or a company lock refuses new payments.
items: Pause all tills locks the company and force-closes open sessions.
Resume all tills clears only the company lock. A till you paused on its own stays paused.

bulkMenu.label: Company controls
bulkMenu.pauseAllHint: Lock the company and force-close open sessions
bulkMenu.resumeAllHint: Clear the company lock only. Individually paused tills stay paused
